column12: Graciously accord, O Lord, to bless the waters of the river this year.

column12: Pray for the rising of the waters of the rivers this year, that Christ our God may bless them and raise them according to their measure, that He may give joy to the face of the earth, sustain us, the sons of men, save the cattle, and forgive us our sins.
